title: Tim Phillips says triangles are real

tellings.quote: Tim Phillips himself said triangles are real. They want to know where they're coming from.

plain: Tim Phillips, an official at AARO, the Pentagon office set up in the 2020s to investigate unexplained aerial reports, is said to have stated that triangle-shaped craft are real and that the office wants to know where they come from. Dylan Borland, a former US Air Force intelligence specialist, relays this, citing Phillips himself and the journalist Chris Sharp. If true, it would mean the office itself accepts these triangles as a real puzzle.
